why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.81% with the Ranker v7 model as the only parameter that differs between arms.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: The segment cuts of Successful Search Rate (mobile, desktop, head, tail) show no clear segment carrying the lift, so the mechanism is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate would mean the test is broken and the result cannot be trusted.
A daily series by days since first exposure showing the lift fading toward zero in the last days would mean the effect is a novelty and needs more time.
An owner correction to the 0.50% bar or the guardrail margins would reopen the call.
